The '''Shard Memorial''' was a monument built on a peaceful, if remote and relatively unknown, [[Unidentified planet (Shard Memorial)|planet]], as a tribute to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="Topps" /> a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Death Star/Legends|battlestation]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> It was a jutting slab of [[Color/Legends|light blue]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] placed in a [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] field of a region of hills.<ref name="Topps" />

The memorial served as a place of remembrance,<ref name="Topps" /> and in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of Alderaan's [[House of Organa/Legends|royal family]] visited it. [[Limb/Legends|Kneeling]] before the monument, the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] was reminded of the crystalline walls of<ref name="Topps" /> the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]], the House of Organa's residence that had existed on Alderaan.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shard Memorial was introduced on a card of [[2015 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back|2015 Topps ''Star Wars'' Illustrated: ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], a [[Topps]] trading card set<ref name="Topps" /> released on [[April 29]], [[2015]].<ref name="Facebook 4/29">{{Facebook|username=OfficialToppsStarWars|url=OfficialToppsStarWars/photos/a.305898082871093.1073741825.274996949294540/701814056612825|name=[[Topps]] Star Wars|date=2015-04-29|quote=Topps Star Wars Illustrated: The Empire Strikes Back trading cards are out in Hobby shops now!|archivefile=File:ToppsSWIESB.png}}</ref> The card was illustrated by [[Grant Gould]].<ref name="Topps" />
